_comment: CI gate thresholds for the evaluation harness (master prompt §9).
A PR fails when a headline metric moves beyond the tolerance below.
'min' means a HIGHER value is better; 'max' means a LOWER value is better.
The baselines are the measured numbers of the current system after the Phase 1 fixes
(D-01, D-54, D-57) - see docs/PHASE1_EVALUATION.md. Lowering a threshold is a
deliberate, reviewed change: raise the number only when a regression is accepted.
The fixture-corpus thresholds for the pull-request gate live in eval_gate_ci.json.
